name: Prosonic Android TV (Vestel-built, BODRUM, finch, MediaTek m7332), Denmark
warnings: Netflix and Prime buttons: MediaTek's hotkey service (com.mediatek.tv.service) receives both as global buttons and starts Netflix / Prime Video itself, so the launcher's app_keys never see them; with both apps disabled the start fails quietly ("result code=-91" / "-92" in the log).

Held volume: with a key-filtering accessibility helper on (the launcher's key_filter), a held volume key stops ramping, and filtered volume keys never reach the helper, so consume_volume_keys cannot bring it back.
Leave key_filter off on this set.
